title: DSH port changed and discovered from DSH_WEB_URL
titleZh: DSH 端口被改,从 DSH_WEB_URL 发现
why: defensive-spec section 1.2 level 2: DSH_WEB_URL is the authoritative source DSH itself injects, so it must outrank any built-in default. The same case also proves the default is not leaking into the output: the string 43120 must not appear anywhere in the report when the port is 49999.
inject: environment DSH_WEB_URL=http://127.0.0.1:49999 with no -Port on the command line
expectSummary: config dshPort=49999 source=env:DSH_WEB_URL, DSH_LOOPBACK_ONLY pass, and 43120 appears nowhere
